en: Black-and-white interior view of a Roman Catholic church taken from the central aisle looking toward the high altar. The nave has wooden pews on both sides and balconies with wooden railings above. The sanctuary wall is covered with large murals showing scenes from the life of Christ, with a prominent crucifix at the center surrounded by rays of light and groups of saints. Additional narrative frescoes fill the arched ceiling above the chancel. Lighting fixtures hang from a relatively plain, modern-style ceiling, suggesting an early‑to‑mid 20th‑century church. No clear postcard caption or border is visible on the image itself.
